hooks.command:

' "$E" | python3 -B "$F" hook guard) && { [ -z "$O" ] || printf '%s
' "$O"; exit 0; }; fi; R=$(printf '%s' "${WORKFLOW_ROLE:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//'); if [ -f "$F" ]; then P="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/workflow/profile.toml"; if [ -z "$R" ] && [ -f "$P" ]; then B=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); T=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*ticket_branch[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*["'"'"']\([^"'"'"']*\)["'"'"'].*/\1/p' "$P" | head -n 1); case "$B" in HEAD|"") ;; ${T:-claude/build-*}) R=ticket;; esac; fi; fi; if [ -z "$R" ] || [ "$R" = attended ]; then if [ -f "$F" ] && [ -f "${F%.py}/fallback.sh" ]; then printf '%s
' "$E" | sh "${F%.py}/fallback.sh"; elif [ -f "$F" ]; then printf '%s
' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The workflow kit is broken (python3 could not run it, and its fallback.sh is missing), so the guard cannot check anything and asks about every tool. Restore the kit (a vendored project: git checkout -- .claude/workflow; the plugin: reinstall it) and check python3 --version (3.11 or newer), then start a new session."}}'; fi; exit 0; fi; if [ -f "$F" ]; then printf '%s

' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"the workflow kit is missing from this checkout (.claude/workflow/bin/workflow.py); restore it with: git checkout -- .claude/workflow"}}'

F="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/workflow/bin/workflow.py"; if [ -f "$F" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -B "$F" hook repair && exit 0; fi; if [ -f "$F" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Workflow kit: python3 could not run the workflow kit (it is missing or failing, or the kit failed: an invalid profile, a broken checkout), so nothing can be checked; check python3 --version (3.11 or newer is needed) and python3 .claude/workflow/bin/workflow.py profile check, then start a new session."}'; fi; exit 0
